name: ifc-lite-headless-example
description: Headless script: load IFC, count walls, process geometry. Always benchmarks LATEST PUBLISHED @ifc-lite (npm) for WASM and latest main (source worktree) for native.

scripts.update:latest: npm install @ifc-lite/data@latest @ifc-lite/geometry@latest @ifc-lite/parser@latest @ifc-lite/query@latest @ifc-lite/wasm@latest && cd webifc && npm install web-ifc@latest
